feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 18 June 2026 5:39am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Wind)##

S or SW 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the morning.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate becoming moderate in the afternoon.


##Weather)##

Rain, heavy at times, becoming mainly fair during the afternoon, with mist and fog later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and very poor in fog later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

S or SW 5 or 6, decreasing 3 to 5 later in the afternoon.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Rain arriving in the morning, heavy at times, becoming mostly fair in the evening. Ongoing risk of areas of mist and fog patches.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and rain and very poor in fog.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Saturday, 20 June 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

W or SW 3 or 4, decreasing 3 or less overnight, backing mainly E or SE later, but variable at times.


##State of sea)##

Slight, decreasing smooth or slight overnight.


##Weather)##

Fair, although risk of mist/fog at first.


##Visibility)##

Good, risk of poor or very poor at first.


##Temperature##

13°C

Nil.

Good.

Nil.
